environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in a private subnet (10.0.128.0/20) within VPC vpc-0a3f7c9e2b1d4. Subnet route table rtb-0f8a2c has local route only (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) with no NAT gateway, no VPC endpoint for S3/SSM/internet, and no transit gateway attachment. Security group sg-0d4e7f allows inbound only from internal ALB (sg-0b2a9c) on port 3000, egress rules allow TCP 5432 to RDS subnet only (10.0.192.0/20). VPC Flow Logs confirm zero packets to destinations outside 10.0.0.0/16 in trailing 90 days. Task execution role has no network-related permissions (no ec2:CreateNetworkInterface beyond what ECS requires for ENI attachment in the subnet).
